rows.note: This is the colloquial choice for a situation or outcome that has gone disastrously wrong.

example.english: This project has had a disastrous outcome.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 gung1 cing4 zan1 hai6 daai6 wok6

rows.note: Use this as the precise, formal description of something calamitous or likely to cause disaster.

example.english: This policy could have disastrous consequences.
example.traditional: 呢項政策可能帶來災難性後果。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 zing3 caak3 ho2 nang4 daai3 loi4 zoi1 naan6 sing3 hau6 gwo2

rows.note: Use this when something is regarded as an ill omen or as foreboding bad luck.

example.english: Breaking a vase before the wedding is a disastrous omen.
example.traditional: 婚禮前打爛個花樽，真係唔吉利。
example.jyutping: fan1 lai5 cin4 daa2 laan6 go3 faa1 zeon1 zan1 hai6 m4 gat1 lei6
